text_block_list.text:
After Sakura Bakushin O didn't show up to 
practice, the next morning……when I headed 
to the Trainer's office, I heard a strange 
voice.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Welcome, Trainer! We have just finished 
the banners for the press conference!

Surprised, I look down at her feet and saw 
a banner that read…… "Sakura Bakushin O, 
Apology Conference!" spread out on the 
floor.
choice_data_list: You don't have to go that far…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
But I do! As the exemplary class 
president, I have to draw the line!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Now, I will begin my apology conference! I 
am well and truly, deeply, honestly…… 
sorry!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
On the Bakushin road that goes straight 
down… I forgot myself, I began to run… and 
before I knew it, it was night…!
choice_data_list: Alright, just be careful next time.
Okay, just be careful next time.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I promise! I will never be tempted again!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
And now! I plan to use this banner as a 
quilt!!

…She expressed enough remorse that I 
stopped her from going that far.
